name: team-ai-marketplace
description: The team's Claude Code plugins: a paved road of engineering skills, research and architecture-review agents, and a spec-driven development workflow.

plugins.name: engineering-paved-path
plugins.description: The team's paved road for TypeScript web work: React, Next.js App Router, Fastify, onion and frontend architecture, React Testing Library and application security skills.

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: A read-only researcher agent that answers questions about a codebase or a library with path:line and URL evidence, before anything is planned.

plugins.name: architecture-review
plugins.description: A read-only architecture reviewer for diffs: layering and the dependency rule, module boundaries, shared contracts, frontend layout. Uses the paved-path architecture skills.

plugins.name: sdd-engineering
plugins.description: Spec-driven development: spec-creator, implementation-planner, implementer and plan-verifier agents, the run-plan and workflow-retro skills, EARS rules, templates and a traceability check.
